notes.title: Automation
notes.content:
Hi!
Automation Update is here!

What's new:
- Auto seeding, harvesting, and watering
- Assembler
- Sprinkler
- Market Stall: auto-sell your items
- Construction removal
- New achievements
- Animal animation fixed

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Gameplay polishing
notes.content:
[b]Hi![/b]
There was a long week...
I recommend starting a new game after this update!

[list]
[*] New crop: onion
[*] Salad maker: vegetable salad recipe
[*] Grill: baked potatoes and grilled corn recipes
[*] Crafting automation
[*] Game balance fixes
[*] Map rework
[*] New sound effects
[*] Optimized game loading
[/list]

Next week, I'll work on the [b]Animals Update[/b].
Have a great weekend! Thanks!
